subject.title: Dashboard sidebar lost agents/sessions sections after 2026-07-01 update

question: Should Agents and Sessions return as default pinned routes, or should this issue be narrowed to proving and fixing a missing or undiscoverable More/customize control?
rationale: Current source intentionally pins only Overview, so restoring the prior full navigation is a product choice; a rendering fix is appropriate only after proving the replacement control is unavailable.

options.title: Prove replacement-path bug
options.body: Request a screenshot or short browser recording with viewport dimensions, then fix More/customize if it is absent, clipped, or inaccessible.

options.title: Restore default pins
options.body: Make Agents and Sessions visible by default again, intentionally revising the 2026.7.1 sidebar direction.

options.title: Keep and clarify redesign
options.body: Retain current defaults and improve in-product onboarding after confirming that More/customize works correctly.

recommendation.title: Prove replacement-path bug
recommendation.body: Request a screenshot or short browser recording with viewport dimensions, then fix More/customize if it is absent, clipped, or inaccessible.

likelyOwner.reason: Available release provenance connects vincentkoc to the release that introduced and documented the Control UI overhaul, although direct sidebar ownership is unproven.
